# Decision - Freeze cataloging during cutover week

## Context

The [[Project Kestrel|catalog migration]] copies every record from Bookwright in one export. Any record added or edited after the export would be lost when Fernbank goes live.

## Decision

No new records and no edits from March 9 through March 13. New materials wait on a cart in each branch workroom and get processed after go-live.

## Exceptions

- Interlibrary loan items, which get a temporary brief record in Fernbank.
- Withdrawals of damaged items, which are noted on a list and applied after go-live.

## Consequences

Roughly 900 new items sat unprocessed for a week. The [[Retrospective - Moving to Fernbank]] records how long the backlog took to clear.
